class.name: SuperpositionWorld
class.brief_description: Inspector session setup and lifecycle for Superposition.
class.description: Owns and polls one native [EGPNetSession] for a scene subtree. Add this node above [Superposition] and [SuperpositionSpawner] nodes to let them discover the session automatically. Select matching protocol, simulation fingerprint, tick rate and capacities in the Inspector. For a local test, enable [member allow_insecure_loopback], choose the server or local client [member role], and enable [member auto_start]. For authenticated clients, obtain a server-issued token through your application's admission service and call [method join_token]. Tokens and signing keys are supplied at runtime and are not Inspector properties. [method stop] releases the owned session; a later start creates a fresh session and child components rebind. Inspect [method get_statistics] and [signal network_error] for failures.

method.name: configure
method.description: Creates a session using the Inspector settings, overridden by [param options]. Accepts the same options and validation as [method EGPNetSession.configure]. Returns [constant ERR_ALREADY_IN_USE] while a session exists; call [method stop] before changing configuration. On success, forwards session signals and emits [signal session_changed].

method.name: get_session
method.description: Returns the owned session, or null before configuration and after [method stop]. This provider method lets descendant components bind without an explicit session path.

method.name: get_statistics
method.description: Returns state, last_error and a nested session dictionary from [method EGPNetSession.get_statistics]. The same diagnostics are available in the Inspector's read-only Status fields.

method.name: join_loopback
method.description: Configures a session if needed and begins an asynchronous connection to [member address] and [member port]. Requires [member allow_insecure_loopback]; only literal loopback addresses are accepted. [constant OK] means the attempt started. Wait for [signal state_changed] to report Connected.

method.name: join_token
method.description: Configures a session if needed and starts a secure asynchronous connection using a 2048-byte server-issued [param token] for [param client_id]. [param binding] selects the client socket address. Keep tokens private and obtain a fresh token after expiration or resynchronization. Wait for Connected; [constant OK] alone does not establish admission.

method.name: poll
method.description: Polls the owned native session once. Returns [constant ERR_UNCONFIGURED] without a session. With [member auto_poll] enabled, the node already polls each frame; disable it before taking over manual polling. Methods and callbacks belong to the session's creating thread.

method.name: start
method.description: Starts the configured [member role]: server calls [method start_server], local client calls [method join_loopback]. Authenticated remote clients must call [method join_token] instead.

method.name: start_server
method.description: Configures a session if needed and starts listening on [member port]. Binds to 127.0.0.1 in development loopback mode and 0.0.0.0 otherwise. Returns the native listen error and reports failures through [signal network_error].

method.name: stop
method.description: Stops and releases the owned session, disconnects forwarded signals and emits [signal session_changed]. Safe to call repeatedly. Child components discover the replacement session after a subsequent start; authoritative gameplay persistence remains the application's responsibility.

members.member: Literal local-test destination address, normally 127.0.0.1. Secure token connections take their server endpoint from the token instead.
Enables direct development connections on literal loopback addresses only. Both local peers must opt in. Remote connections use encrypted admission tokens.
Polls the owned session every frame, before ordinary gameplay nodes. Disable this when another owner calls [method poll].
Starts [member role] when the node enters the running scene. Editor previews do not start networking. A local client also requires explicit loopback permission.
Nonempty application protocol identifier used in native compatibility admission. Must match across peers.
Native replicated entity capacity, from 1 to 4096. Include spawned membership entities and property components in the capacity plan.
Native session client capacity, from 1 to 64. Use matching admission settings on peers.
Server listen or local client destination port. Servers may use 0 for an ephemeral port; clients require a nonzero destination.
Auto-start mode: 0 starts a server; 1 starts a local testing client. This selection does not issue authentication tokens or start a remote secure client.
Nonempty simulation profile identifier used with protocol and tick rate in admission. Matching identifiers are a game contract and do not by themselves prove deterministic simulation.
Fixed native simulation tick rate, from 1 to 240 Hz. Must match across peers. After configuration, reports the configured rate.

signal.name: application_received
signal.description: Forwards a reliable ordered application payload of at most 4096 bytes. Validate game-specific data before use.

signal.name: diagnostic
signal.description: Forwards a native diagnostic, including thread or simulation catch-up failures.

signal.name: network_error
signal.description: Emitted when a lifecycle or polling operation fails, with its [enum Error] and a diagnostic message. Tokens and signing keys are not included.

signal.name: packet_received
signal.description: Forwards a raw packet and its logical channel and delivery mode. See [signal EGPNetSession.packet_received] for limits.

signal.name: peer_connected
signal.description: Forwards successful native admission. Server peer IDs identify connection generations; clients use peer 0 for the server.

signal.name: peer_disconnected
signal.description: Forwards native disconnection. Discard peer-generation-specific ownership and observer state.

signal.name: session_changed
signal.description: Emitted when configuration installs a session or stopping releases it. Resolve [method get_session] again rather than retaining a stale binding.

signal.name: simulation_tick
signal.description: Forwards a fixed simulation tick and whether this session is authoritative. Client ticks begin after baseline synchronization.

signal.name: state_changed
signal.description: Forwards the native transport state transition. Connected follows completion of the authoritative entity baseline.
